question_en: Are the 28 LTM capability items loaded as CapabilityItem nodes (LTM baseline check)?
original_query: MATCH (cap:CapabilityItem) WHERE cap.capabilityItemName STARTS WITH 'ltm-' AND cap.granularity = 'item' RETURN count(cap) AS ltm_cap_count, collect(cap.capabilityItemName)[..10] AS sample
reference_query:
UNWIND ["LTM-CSI-ReportConfig-r18", "LTM-CSI-ReportConfig-r19", "LTM-CSI-ResourceConfig-r18", "ltm-BeamIndicationJointTCI-CSI-RS-r19", "ltm-BeamIndicationJointTCI-r18", "ltm-BeamIndicationSeparateTCI-CSI-RS-r19", "ltm-BeamIndicationSeparateTCI-r18", "ltm-EventMeasAndReport-r19", "ltm-FastProcessingConfig-r18", "ltm-FastUE-Processing-r18", "ltm-InterFreq-r18", "ltm-InterFreqMeasGap-r18", "ltm-KeyUpdateMCG-r19", "ltm-KeyUpdateSCG-r19", "ltm-MAC-CE-JointTCI-CSI-RS-r19", "ltm-MAC-CE-JointTCI-r18", "ltm-MAC-CE-SeparateTCI-CSI-RS-r19", "ltm-MAC-CE-SeparateTCI-r18", "ltm-MCG-IntraFreq-r18", "ltm-MCG-NRDC-Release-r18", "ltm-MCG-NRDC-r18", "ltm-RACH-LessCG-r18", "ltm-RACH-LessDG-r18", "ltm-Recovery-r18", "ltm-RecoveryWithKeyUpdate-r19", "ltm-ReferenceConfig-r18", "ltm-SCG-IntraFreq-r18", "ltm-interFreqL1-OnlyInBC-r18"] AS expectedName
OPTIONAL MATCH (cap:CapabilityItem)
WHERE cap.capabilityItemName = expectedName AND cap.specNumber = '38.306' AND cap.granularity = 'item'
WITH expectedName, count(cap) > 0 AS loaded
WITH collect(loaded) AS expectedItemLoaded
RETURN all(loaded IN expectedItemLoaded WHERE loaded) AS all_loaded

required_fields.name: all_loaded
required_fields.source_column_or_expression: all exact source-defined baseline28 identities have an item-level CapabilityItem node for spec38.306
